elements.manual_reason: The whole Fields list scrolls as one unit inside the side panel; candidate boxes only cover individual rows or the over-wide union b01 that includes the static table.
elements.label: Fields panel list (scrolling)
Mouse cursor moving down the toggle column

pattern.description: Screen-recorded Fields side panel scrolls its list of fields inside the fixed panel while the cursor hovers down the toggle column; rows highlight on hover and a brief tooltip flashes over Comments.
pattern.why_premium: The list moves inside a fixed mask so the rest of the UI stays anchored; the eye follows the cursor to the next toggle, setting up the add-field action without a cut.

build_hint.gsap: Clip the list in an overflow-hidden panel; gsap.to(list, {y: -scrollDistance, duration: 0.9, ease: 'power2.out'}) in sync with gsap.to(scrollThumb, {y: thumbDistance, duration: 0.9, ease: 'power2.out'}); cursor via gsap.to(cursor, {y: rowY, duration: 0.6, ease: 'power1.inOut'}) and row hover background via a short 0.1s fade to the highlight colour.
build_hint.remotion: translateY on the list = interpolate(frame, [0, 27], [0, -scrollDistance], {easing: Easing.out(Easing.quad), extrapolateRight: 'clamp'}) inside an overflow:hidden container; scrollbar thumb mapped to the same progress; cursor position interpolated with Easing.inOut(Easing.quad); hover row opacity toggled when cursor y enters the row.

notes: Real screen recording (wheel scroll), not a designed animation. A tooltip ('The number of comments added to the idea') appears briefly mid-burst near the Comments row and is gone by the end frame, so it has no box. Energy shows several scroll steps rather than one smooth glide.
